# External Sources

This directory may later be used to manage external source trees such as:

- XRoboToolkit-PC-Service
- XRoboToolkit-PC-Service-Pybind
- unitreerobotics/xr_teleoperate

For this phase, do not clone, copy, or modify those repositories here.

If external code is introduced later, prefer either:

- git submodules, or
- a separate clone with an explicitly recorded commit hash

Do not lose upstream version provenance by copying code without traceability.
